loop.algorithm: Evenly-spaced streamlines of a divergence-free field: v = (∂ψ/∂y, −∂ψ/∂x), ψ = 4-octave Perlin fbm
loop.technique: RK2 midpoint integration, 5 px step; Jobard–Lefer style separation via a 9 px occupancy grid so lines stop when they near a neighbour

cron.technique: Rows at y = h + (H−h)(i/26)^2.5; 69 columns share the vanishing point (800, 470); sun is a gradient disc under a mask of 9 slits whose height grows linearly; scanline pattern + SVG gaussian bloom

token.technique: x′ = ox + (gx−gy)·32, y′ = oy + (gx+gy)·16 − z; 15×15 grid of prisms with height = fbm(gx,gy)·300·((2N−gx−gy)/2N)^1.9; painter's algorithm sorted by gx+gy; per-face shading by mixing toward navy; "coin seams" every 14 px of height

cache.technique: Luminance field = 5-octave Perlin fbm + radial falloff; each 6 px cell is lit when L > (B8[y&7][x&7] + ½)/64; lit cells run-length merged into one path per colour; palette cuts from cool "fresh" to sepia "stale" at 52 % width

patch.technique: Each bus is a monotone polyline of 40 px grid runs and 45° rises; its 4–9 lanes are exact translates at 14 px pitch, so they stay parallel and never cross. Candidate buses are rejected when >22 % of samples land in cells already occupied (20 px occupancy hash). Half run vertically via an axis swap.

prompt.technique: Random 320-cell seed row with wrap-around; next[x] = (110 >> (L·4 + C·2 + R)) & 1; 180 generations drawn top→bottom as 5 px cells, coloured in six horizontal bands, run-length merged. Rule 110 is Turing-complete — a fitting wallpaper for an agent that agrees to everything.

bandwidth.technique: 50 px tiles, each a pair of quarter-circle arcs in one of two orientations; tile removal probability p(x) = 0.9·smoothstep(0.38, 1, x/W)^1.1 simulates packet loss growing toward the right edge; four colour classes batched into four paths

firewall.technique: Running-bond bricks (96×36, 4 px mortar). Heat h = (y/H)^1.7·1.15 + 0.32·fbm(0.006x, 0.012y) mapped through a 5-stop ramp charcoal→ember→orange→yellow; mortar is the same ramp +0.28 so joints glow brighter than faces; three flame layers from 1-D fbm; 180 embers with y-biased distribution

legacy.technique: Monospace listing drawn three times (red −2.2 px, blue +2.2 px, green 0) for chromatic aberration; green pass gets a double gaussian bloom; RGB aperture-grille tiles (6×3 px triad), 4×3 scanline mask, feTurbulence phosphor grain, radial vignette and a 170 px rolling hum bar; screen is a 70 px-radius rounded rect to fake tube curvature

ping.technique: Six ridges from 5-octave 1-D fbm at increasing frequency/darkness (aerial perspective); stratus bank = feTurbulence fractalNoise (baseFrequency 0.0032×0.017, 4 octaves) → colour matrix alpha = 1.7·A − 0.62, masked by a vertical gaussian-ish fade; skyline of 40+ blocks with randomised lit windows
